description: Dreadnaught Legplates Level 60 Korfax at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Dreadnaught Legplates if you bring him the following items: 1 Desecrated Legplates, 20 Wartorn Plate Scraps, 4 Arcanite Bars and 3 Cured Rugged Hides. Requirements: - Desecrated Legplates - Wartorn Plate Scrap x 20 - Arcanite Bar x 4 - Cured Rugged Hide x 3
name: Dreadnaught Legplates
